# Source notes: provenance, ambiguities and limitations

- Source: *The UI/UX Playbook: Tips & Tricks for Exceptional Design*, uxpeak (uxpeak.com), 144 PDF pages.
- Text layer: None. Every page is an image; text was obtained by OCR (RapidOCR) and verified by visual inspection of 2x renders of all 144 pages.
- In the source, a pink thumbs-down icon marks an incorrect example and a green thumbs-up icon marks a correct example.
- Statements under 'What the PDF states' are paraphrases, not quotations; short quoted phrases only.
- 'Interpretation' bullets are our reading of images and are not attributed to the PDF.
- Measurements (px, hex colours, ratios) are the PDF's example values unless an entry says otherwise; they are not universal settings.
- The plugin does not include the PDF. Source crops are kept for reference with their page numbers.

## Source issues and ambiguities (by principle)

- [VH-05](principles/02-visual-hierarchy.md#vh-05) (PDF 12): The two property cards show different prices (£1,273,279 vs £3,273,279); this appears to be a source inconsistency unrelated to the lesson.
- [CON-01](principles/06-contrast.md#con-01) (PDF 21): The third ticket is labelled 'Blocked' in green in both versions; likely a source labelling slip. The lesson concerns contrast, not wording.
- [WS-03](principles/08-whitespace.md#ws-03) (PDF 28, 29): On this page the correct example is on the LEFT and the incorrect on the RIGHT, the reverse of most pages.
- [LAY-03](principles/09-layout.md#lay-03) (PDF 33): Currency differs between versions (£ vs $); source inconsistency.
- [BAL-03](principles/10-balance.md#bal-03) (PDF 36): Text-only principle; no dedicated visual example.
- [CNS-01](principles/11-consistency.md#cns-01) (PDF 38, 39): 'Consistency' appears in the principles grid (pdf page 6) but has no separate table-of-contents entry; its pages sit inside the Balance and harmony range.
- [COL-02](principles/14-color.md#col-02) (PDF 67, 68, 69): The portfolio example labels two segments 'Cash' (25% and 60%); a source labelling slip unrelated to the lesson.
- [COL-03](principles/14-color.md#col-03) (PDF 70): Text-only recommendation; no visual comparison.
- [TYP-03](principles/15-typography.md#typ-03) (PDF 75, 76, 96, 97): The source writes 'Sources Sans Pro' (presumably Source Sans Pro).
- [TYP-04](principles/15-typography.md#typ-04) (PDF 76, 77, 78, 79, 80): In the first correct design the text block is centred on the page but its lines are left-aligned (ragged right); 'center-aligned' refers to block placement, not text-align:center.
- [TYP-07](principles/15-typography.md#typ-07) (PDF 83, 96, 97): The correct dark card still uses a pure black background; the rule concerns text colours.
- [TYP-09](principles/15-typography.md#typ-09) (PDF 86, 93, 95, 97): SUPPLEMENTAL CHECK (not from the PDF): by the WCAG formula #626262 on white is about 6.1:1, which passes AA (4.5:1) but not AAA for normal text (7:1). The source's 'AAA pass' label appears to be inaccurate; verify AAA claims with a checker.
- [TYP-11](principles/15-typography.md#typ-11) (PDF 88, 89): On the watch-card page the correct example is shown first (top) and the incorrect second (bottom).
- [TYP-12](principles/15-typography.md#typ-12) (PDF 90, 96, 97): Two thresholds appear: avoid main text below 12px (pdf p90) and avoid any font smaller than 10px (checklist, pdf p96). Treat <12px main text as a problem and <10px as a strong violation.
- [TYP-14](principles/15-typography.md#typ-14) (PDF 92, 95, 96, 97): Visual ambiguity: in the incorrect card, the annotation labels read 'Line-height: 120%' and '160%' (the same as the correct card), but the rendering clearly shows a loose heading and tight paragraph. The labels appear to describe the target values, not the incorrect card. This knowledge base follows the rendered visual and the text.
- [IC-02](principles/16-interaction-cost.md#ic-02) (PDF 99, 100, 108): The 'Keep related actions close' heading and paragraph appear twice (pdf p99 and p100).
- [IC-03](principles/16-interaction-cost.md#ic-03) (PDF 101): SOURCE ERROR: the body text under 'Minimize choice' duplicates strategy 1's text verbatim.
- [FRM-01](principles/17-forms.md#frm-01) (PDF 114, 115): SOURCE ORDER ERROR: the text calls the four-box design 'the first example', but in the figure the four-box version is on the right with the green thumbs-up and the single field is on the left with the pink thumbs-down. The lesson itself is unambiguous.
- [FRM-04](principles/17-forms.md#frm-04) (PDF 119): SOURCE ERROR: the body text under 'Use inline password validation' duplicates the show/hide toggle paragraph.
- [DLG-01](principles/18-dialogs.md#dlg-01) (PDF 120, 121): The 'Following conventions…' paragraph is printed twice on pdf p121.
- [BT-01](principles/19-content-and-states.md#bt-01) (PDF 126, 127): The source text contains typos ('tak', 'compare to') not relevant to the lesson.

## Page-level notes

- PDF p.1 (cover): Title and publisher branding only. No guidance extracted.
- PDF p.2 (table of contents): Lists chapters: Introduction, Visual hierarchy, Proximity, Clarity, Alignment, Contrast, Simplicity, Whitespace, Layout, Balance and harmony, Visual cues, Depth and texture, Colour, Typography, Interaction cost, Bonus tips, Level up. Used to build the chapter structure; no guidance extracted.
- PDF p.6 (principle overview): Grid naming the 15 principles (including Consistency, which has no TOC entry). Used for chapter structure; no separate guidance.
- PDF p.99 (content): Gesture-icon grid is decorative. The 'Keep related actions close' heading/paragraph is repeated on the next page.
- PDF p.100 (content): Repeats the strategy-1 heading and paragraph from pdf p99 (source duplication) and adds the Spotify screenshot.
- PDF p.101 (content): SOURCE ERROR: 'Minimize choice' body text duplicates strategy 1. Guidance for IC-03 is interpretation of the figure only.
- PDF p.110 (chapter intro): Bonus tips introduction with a collage previewing examples that appear in full on pdf pp114-142. No separate guidance.
- PDF p.115 (content): Text refers to the four-box code input as 'the first example', but it is the right-hand (correct) example on pdf p114.
- PDF p.119 (content): SOURCE ERROR: 'Use inline password validation' body text duplicates the show/hide toggle paragraph.
- PDF p.143 (closing): Closing advice (test with real users) captured as FND-02; feedback/Trustpilot request and website link are not guidance.
- PDF p.144 (back cover / advertisement): Course advertisement with a discount code and decorative UI mockups. No guidance extracted.

## Limitations

- OCR misread some small UI text inside figures; figure text in this knowledge base was checked visually, but tiny annotation text may still contain errors.
- Several principles (IC-03, FRM-04) rest only on a heading plus a figure because the PDF repeats unrelated text under them; their guidance is marked as interpretation.
- The PDF gives heuristics, not research results for your product; recommend user testing for consequential decisions (FND-02).
